subject: Issue with invoice VEN022-0015 – input tax credit
body:
Dear Evergreen Motors Pvt Ltd team,

We are reconciling our purchases with GSTR-2B and found that invoice VEN022-0015 dated 24 Sep 2025 is not reported by GSTIN 08VCMUN9851R2ZI in the September 2025 and October 2025 returns. Rs 3,994 of input tax credit is at risk.

Please report the invoice in your return and confirm once it appears. We will hold the credit note until it is reflected.

Regards,
Accounts team
Sharma Traders Pvt Ltd
GSTIN 07AAACS1234F1ZU
